programme.title: Secret Knowledge
programme.desc: Lucy Worsley tells the story of Bolsover Castle in Derbyshire. Built in the early 17th century, Bolsover Castle became the pleasure palace of playboy Cavalier and ambitious courtier William Cavendish.

programme.title: Welsh Greats
programme.desc: From Swansea Council house boy to beloved singer, actor, comedian and presenter, Sir Harry ruled the airwaves with shows ranging from the `Goon Show' and `Pickwick to Highway' and `Songs of Praise'. With the help of Peter Sellers and Spike Milligan, the programme illustrates his infectious humour and deep-felt faith, and reminds us of his tragic battle with a stroke and cancer.

programme.title: Inside Classical
programme.desc: The thrilling ballet score takes centre stage in a dazzling concert from the BBC Symphony Orchestra at London's Barbican Hall. Presented by Georgia Mann.

programme.desc: More than any other continent, North America is defined by extreme weather and seasonal change. For animals that live here this poses great challenges, but for those with a pioneering spirit it can also offer great rewards.

programme.title: Treasures of Ancient Egypt
programme.desc: Alastair Sooke looks at how, despite political decline, the final era of the Egyptian Empire saw its art enjoy revival and rebirth. From the colossal statues of Rameses II that proclaimed the pharaoh's power to the final flourishes under Queen Cleopatra, Sooke discovers that the subsequent invasions by foreign rulers, from the Nubians and Alexander the Great to the Romans, produced a new hybrid art full of surprise.

programme.title: Call My Bluff
programme.desc: Robert Robinson hosts as Frank Muir, Gayle Hunnicutt and Russell Davies take on Patrick Campbell, Prunella Scales and Paul Eddington in the panel game of word definitions and deceptions.

programme.title: Face the Music

programme.title: Caroline Walker: Women's Work
programme.desc: Acclaimed Scottish artist Caroline Walker paints the invisible labour that shapes women's lives, from housework to caregiving to creative production.

programme.title: Art That Made Us
programme.desc: A look at the turbulent era that followed the Roman occupation of Britain. Once known as the `dark' ages, in reality it's a time of glittering art and extraordinary cultural fusions.

programme.title: Chauvet: Humanity's First Great Masterpiece
programme.desc: Documentary that follows a 30-year archaeological, geological and artistic adventure as scientists endeavour to understand and conserve the extraordinary art of the Chauvet cave.

programme.title: The Mystery of the Desert Kites
programme.desc: Documentary following an international team of archaeologists and researchers as they explore the extraordinary groups of megastructures that stretch across the Arabian desert. Who built them, when and for what purpose? Using cutting-edge technologies, the multidisciplinary team uncovers the groundbreaking history of the desert kites. These remarkable and ingenious structures predate the Egyptian pyramids and Stonehenge, and the team's discoveries shed new light on a little-known period.

programme.title: Building Britain's Biggest Nuclear Power Station
programme.desc: With unique behind-the-scenes access, this series follows the construction workers at Hinkley Point C, Britain's biggest and newest nuclear power station, which is being built in a remote corner of the Somerset countryside.

programme.title: This Life
